summary: Owner-scoped search with no exploitable defects or regressions: filter runs after ListNotes(session.UserID) so q can only narrow; 401 precedes query handling; [] never null; UserID not serialized; DELETE id parsing strict with correct slice removal; single renderNotes() funnel keeps create/delete/reload filter-consistent; loading/error/401/empty/search-empty states complete. build/vet/full+targeted tests green. Only low/info hygiene notes.

findings.title: Stale notebook.search sessionStorage can survive into a later login in the same tab on expiry
findings.evidence: SEARCH_KEY cleared only on logout and 401; restored query applies to new user's own notes (no data leak).

findings.title: No retry affordance after non-401 load failure (pre-existing f-v3 behavior)
findings.evidence: setNotesEnabled(false) only re-enabled on 200; core.md §3 says loading/error handling unchanged.

findings.title: No length cap on q; bounded by owner's note count, no panic/500
findings.evidence: TrimSpace/ToLower + strings.Contains over own notes; spec allows unbounded UTF-8 q.
